why: None of the major names answer the question. TechRadar, Good Housekeeping, Car and Driver and Popular Mechanics only have deal posts, and the Verge, SFGate and Strategist pages cover a single product or a different topic. Only RoverSolar and OffGridEmpire come close, and they are small sites with no testing anyone can check. A focused page on small kits under $500 with current prices would stand out.
